review_method: Read-only inspection of three user-supplied PPTX decks (87 slides), slide text/image/context review and visual inspection; six original embedded image files copied without modification; no EDA or hardware execution
role_basis: Author identifies the LPDDR TX circuit design and premeasurement Schematic/Post-Layout verification as individual work. Shared clock/PRBS/ZQ context does not imply sole authorship of every block; RX and whole-chip results remain joint.
scope_notes: November slides 4/39/41 describe test-day simulation and updated submission evidence; no issued accredited certificate or JEDEC/LPDDR6 conformance verdict established by these decks.
Circuit architecture uses 64-bit PRBS/64:4/4:1 serialization, distinct from the separate 32:1 Controller PHY Verilog model.
October FFE-off/on images are a paired comparison: 37 ps/56.5 mV and 45.4 ps/75.1 mV. November 46 ps/75.7 mV is a separate updated simulation record.
November power uses selected-window average-current magnitudes for two TX rails, not instantaneous peaks or an exhaustive PVT/pattern worst case.
127 bits divided by 8.14 ns checks simulated data rate, not measured BER.
Source ZQ MUX setting selects manually supplied codes; Eye/current plots alone do not prove autonomous calibration convergence or full-PVT impedance accuracy.
November TX area 0.0201 mm2 includes PRBS, data, driver, ZQ and clock blocks; earlier TX 0.0196 mm2 and TRX 0.0308 mm2 are versioned separately from updated TRX 0.0334 mm2.
TRX 0.91 pJ/bit combines TX 0.76 and RX 0.15; only TX is used for individual TX claims.
Existing ICEIC TX simulation and later Combo PHY joint silicon measurement remain separate conditions/results.
Raw IP code, complete source decks, detailed schematics/layouts, PDK/tool-server screens and private paths excluded; public scope is role/structure description and approved TX validation images.

sources.selection_reason: Updated TX speed, supply-current energy calculation, Eye and area; LVS/PEX/test-day simulation evidence. RX and TRX totals used only for scope distinctions.
TX block diagram and paired FFE-off/on Eye plots; joint result targets are not treated as a compliance certificate.
TX test-environment/PEX flow and manual-ZQ selection context; detailed register code vectors and private circuit/PDK screenshots excluded.
